title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning How to Determine the Misappropriation of Public Funds for Personal Use

articles.content_en: Article 1 Where a State functionary, by taking advantage of his office, lends public funds in his own name to another natural person, or to a privately-owned sole proprietorship enterprise, a privately-owned partnership enterprise, or the like that does not have the status of a legal person for use, such conduct shall be deemed as misappropriation of public funds for personal use.

Article 2 Where a State functionary, by taking advantage of his office, for the purpose of pursuing personal gains, lends public funds in his own name to another unit for use, such conduct shall be deemed as misappropriation of public funds for personal use.

Article 3 After this Interpretation comes into force, the provisions of the judicial interpretations previously promulgated by this Court that are inconsistent with this Interpretation shall no longer apply.
